I also want to mention that this novel may not appeal to everyone. It’s not one of those stories where all the gongs suddenly drown in regret and cling to the MC, nor is it written just for readers who are only looking for romance scenes.

I’m currently on chapter 68, and the pacing is slow.

Lastly, I’d like to thank the author for this novel. Even though I’m reading it with a translator, I’m taking my time and trying to understand every word. Author-nim thank you so much for writing this story.
